title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
selection_reason: ChronoStitch composes independently stored per-chunk visual KV caches by re-basing post-rotary keys onto a global three-axis multimodal RoPE coordinate system, enabling training-free KV memory reuse for long-video question answering.
